verses.text: Call out if you want, but who will answer you? Which of the holy angels will you turn to?
Anger kills a foolish person, and jealousy kills a simple one.
I have seen a foolish person putting down roots, but suddenly I saw his home cursed.
His children are far from safety. They are crushed in court, and no one rescues them.
Hungry people eat up his harvest, taking it even from among the thorns. Thirsty people long for his wealth.
Trouble does not grow out of the dust, and hardship does not sprout from the ground.
But people are born for trouble, as surely as sparks fly upward.
If I were you, I would turn to God. I would bring my case to him.
He does great things that no one can understand, more amazing things than anyone can count.
He sends rain on the earth and water on the fields.
He lifts up those who are low, and lifts those who mourn to safety.
He ruins the plans of tricky people, so their hands do not succeed.
He catches the wise in their own tricks, and the plans of clever people are quickly swept away.
They run into darkness in the daytime. At noon they feel their way as if it were night.
He saves the needy from the sword of their mouths and from the power of the strong.
So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
How happy is the person God corrects! So do not refuse the training of the Almighty.
He hurts, but he also bandages the wound. He injures, but his hands also heal.
He will rescue you from six troubles. Even in seven, no harm will touch you.
In a famine he will save you from death, and in war from the power of the sword.
You will be protected from the whip of the tongue. You will not be afraid when destruction comes.
You will laugh at destruction and hunger, and you will not be afraid of wild animals.
You will have an agreement with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.
You will know that your home is safe. When you check your property, nothing will be missing.
You will know that you will have many children. Your descendants will be like the grass of the earth.
You will come to your grave at a ripe old age, like grain gathered in at harvest time.
Look, we have studied this, and it is true. So listen and learn it for your own good."
